Rich & Hearty Special Mix Beef Pho
Jun 2026 • Solo
I got their Special Mix Beef Pho (Phở Thập Cẩm). The broth was rich and not too salty, but it was heavy and oily. The noodles were perfectly cooked. The assorted beef cuts were tender and generously portioned, making the bowl feel satisfying. While the broth was not aromatic, it still carries a distinctive style and flavor profile. Overall, it was an enjoyable bowl for those who prefer a richer style of pho.

Not as good as we remembered, not sure why. Still feel ok to try it.
Dec 2024 • Family
Tried this few years back and remembered the soup to be soul-nourishing... tried it again this time and it was still alright, but the soup cooled down really fast (in just a few minutes). Wonder if it could be due to the temperature/ freshness of the raw beef prepared, or that they flash-soaked the beef in the soup less this time? The fats from the beef also quickly coagulated and floated to the top of the soup (< 15th minutes). 

Hmm.. there was a difference from before, but we amateurs couldn't tell why. Their highlight, the beef tendon, was a little melty and silky from what I remembered from years ago... it was kinda chewy now, but some people like that too. Then again, the change just makes one wonder what the original/ correct version was supposed to be, by the OG chefs/owners!

Servers were also less enthusiastic, less smiles, lot more tense than before e.g. we got served cold bottled Chrysanthemum tea instead of hot ones we ordered twice from the server (no, it wasn't crowded at 10:30am so he just forgot). Then when we asked to change, the lady manager just snatched away the bottles and scolded the staff loudly for not knowing they don't have hot ones. Nary of a word to us.

Wonder if their new venture (i.e. 10 new outlets in Hong Kong) meant that there was new management here? Then again, their newer, sister outlet at District 3 Vo Van Tan's street weren't open either when we passed by. Mystery lingers on.

Pho Le - VN
Dec 2024 • Couples
Pho Le Vietnamese Restaurant offers a delightful dining experience with its flavorful dishes and warm atmosphere. The pho is the standout, with rich, aromatic broth and perfectly cooked noodles. The menu also features a variety of traditional Vietnamese dishes, such as banh mi and rice plates, all prepared with fresh ingredients. The service is friendly and efficient, adding to the overall positive experience. While the restaurant may be a bit cozy, it’s a great spot for anyone craving authentic Vietnamese flavors. Highly recommended for pho lovers and anyone wanting to explore Vietnamese cuisine!
